description.description: ONE plain-English sentence describing the change — the only thing the user will see. Name the system and what is happening to it. NEVER quote a credential value here; this string is shown to the user and recorded verbatim.

connectionId.description: Required for delete. From read-settings sections:["connections"].

name.description: Required for create; the label the agent addresses this server by, e.g. "Mintlify Docs".

serverUrl.description: Required for create; the MCP server URL. Public hosts only - loopback and private ranges are refused.

instructions.description: Hint for the agent on when to use this source.

scope.description: Defaults "user". "org" shares the server with every member of the organization (org admins only); a member's own connection of the same name still wins.

availableToBackgroundAgents.description: Whether cron/event/automation runs may call this server.

targetUserId.description: Store the entry for ANOTHER user in your organization instead of yourself. Omit for your own, which is almost always what you want.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
